items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I didn't like Sarah Martin singing.

ctx.x: I never cared too much for her singing.

I never liked Ida singing. I didn't like Sarah Martin singing. I didn't like nobody but Bessie. Bessie, yeah. I liked Mama Rene, because Mama Rene was like, oh, you know, she was a ghetto. She was alright, I liked the way she started singing the blues. Bessie and Mama Rene were the two best blues songs I really cared anything for, because we really sang blues.
I heard Bessie several times in New York, but I never did hear Ma Rene. You heard Ma Rene?
